We had not one, but two players come out of nowhere to be TE1s in Week 6 — Tommy Tremble and Foster Moreau. Each receiver had two TDs for their respective team on Sunday, though it was Giants TE Isaiah Likely topping the leaderboard at the position for a second straight week.
 Below, Yahoo analysts Justin Boone, Matt Harmon, Scott Pianowski, Joel Smyth and Hayden Winks provide their tight end rankings for Week 7.
